title: Learn more details about Gen AI + Computer Vision for Surveillance Demo (

contentBody.description:
The demo you just watched features video summarization with CV and RAG-LLM - now known as a language vision model (LVM).  This demo is running on an Intel® Xeon® Scalable server with an Intel® Datacenter GPU Flex 170. 

Find the following assets at this link:
1. PPT outlining visual RAG (retrieval augmented generation)
2. Sample code for a large vision model (Video-LLaVA)
3. Detailed step-by-step instructions.
